verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Superpowers mechanism for pinning skill versions or producing a lockfile. The closest items are Antigravity's 'reinstall to update' note and a third-party `npx skills add --copy` install that vendors files into a project. These are harness or external-tool behaviors and user-side workarounds, not the product's own version-control capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control when skill changes reach my team — pinned versions or a lockfile rather than silent behind-the-back updates
